svg.aria-label: Before, 2016 to 2020. 2016 to 2019: Resurrection Remix, official maintainer for the LG G3, Galaxy Note 3 and Mi A1, 106,689 downloads for the Mi A1. 2018 to 2020: Havoc OS for the Mi A1 and Mi 9T plus a GSI that boots on any Treble phone, 94,683 downloads. 2017 to 2020: Moun Kernel for the LG G3 and Mi A1, 21,042 downloads on GitHub.
